reason: Dice and kappa can appear strong when only a handful of water pixels exist amid a large dry background; require at least 100 water pixels from each method and 100 shared pixels before treating a passing score as substantial evidence.
relationship_to_base_limits: Additional stricter feasibility requirement; the original Dice, kappa and observable-coverage limits remain unchanged.
holdout_state_at_freeze: Only product identity, acquisition metadata and SCL clear-fraction screening have been inspected; no Chaiyaphum v2 water outputs or A/B comparison have been run.
metric_interpretation: Agreement with an automated optical map, not accuracy.
